decisions.reason: The knot is verified but its only Fitness clench anchor refers to a different everyday action; the specialist rope-sense connection is not appropriate here.

The parachuting wildfire firefighter is clearly defined and fits the occupational anchor; retain Canada and US usage labels.
Snow preventing movement or travel is explicitly defined, distinguishing the term from merely snowy weather.
The powdered tobacco noun directly matches the commodity anchor; unrelated violent slang senses remain hidden and no use recommendation is added.
The only candidate repeats societal without explaining the proposed society-wide structural meaning.
Relating to or containing sodium is explicitly sourced for academic chemistry, without adding nutritional advice or equating every sodium compound with dietary salt.
A book with paper covers is a concrete definition for the paperback anchor, with no unsupported formality or geographic claim.

A speech sound accompanied by vocal-cord sound directly verifies the linguistic meaning; it is not restricted to vowels or syllabic sounds.

Validity plus true premises precisely defines argument soundness, avoiding a conflation with mere validity, bodily health or material strength.

Obtaining something from another place is explicitly explained and supports procurement vocabulary, without asserting every use is recruitment.

No exact plural source entry was recovered; a presumed mapping from spectator is not yet an attributable reviewed sense.
The mirror, especially telescope mirror, sense directly supports the anchor; the separate medical instrument and bird markings are not selected.
The industrial zinc and solder meanings are sourced but unrelated to the only Fitness nutritional-zinc context; do not teach impure metal as a nutrition synonym.

Preserve the existing archive: microscopic and other technical needle-like structures do not establish a relevant Fitness needle meaning.

Wisdom in managing public affairs clearly explains the governance meaning without reducing it solely to international diplomacy.

Statues considered collectively directly verifies the sculpture-related noun without an unsupported classical or monumental requirement.
Loyalty despite trouble or difficulty gives an independent explanation of commitment, distinct from general physical stability.
Installing and maintaining steam-carrying pipes is a concrete specialized trade matching the plumber anchor.
The hepatitis subtype characterized by fat accumulation is directly sourced for academic vocabulary, without overstating sole causation or offering clinical advice.
An upright inscribed or decorated slab matches historical tablets and monuments, not the botanical vascular-core homonym.
One small step or stage at a time directly supports incremental process vocabulary; retain the non-comparable adjective label.
